title: Reuse: the components are merged; 739 files are dead

text: The drag, resize, tree and store you named are each one implementation now. What is left is 739 dead files (14,354 lines) behind 26 moved /imagine pages, and one card shape written 27 times. Sixteen readmes written. Say 'prune' and the dead files go in one command.

ask.title: Delete the 739 dead files?
ask.question: May I delete the 739 dead files (14,354 lines) left behind when /imagine/ pages moved, since they are byte-identical to their moved copies?
